cases.name: refresh-absence-versus-api-failure
cases.prompt: A Plugin Framework resource Read decodes its saved widget ID, then calls GET /widgets/{id}. Its current code calls resp.State.RemoveResource(ctx) for every API error. The API distinguishes a typed 404 NotFound, a 401 Unauthorized, and transport timeouts. Review the state-handling behavior and show the minimum correction with tests for these three responses.
cases.trap: Treats any failed read as confirmation that the managed resource no longer exists.
expectations: Removes managed-resource state only for a confirmed not-found response under the API contract.
Keeps prior identity/state on unauthorized and timeout errors and emits diagnostics rather than reporting disappearance.
Proposes distinct checks for 404, 401 and timeout, without claiming real cloud acceptance was executed.
must_not: Must not delete state for arbitrary authentication or transport failures.
